title: End Progression Bosses
description: A lightweight foundation pack that unlocks the End through boss drops.
body:
This is a base modpack built around End Remastered, Mowzie’s Mobs, and L_Ender’s Cataclysm. Each boss drops one specific eye, and the End is unlocked by defeating 12 bosses to collect 12 unique eyes for the End portal.

This modpack was designed for people to use this as a base for their own custom modpack.

Note:
- Removing mods or configs will break the progression.
- All stronghold structure mods should work with this modpack.
- This pack includes only the essential mods, performance depends on your PC and what you add.

A guide book is given when you start a new world. It shows a recommended boss order, but do as you want.

This system was made by me with KubeJS and LootJS
To edit it go to the kubeJS folder, then server_scripts and the files are inside.

Problems or incompatibilities can be posted in the comments for now.

Known incompatibilities: First person model

If you use this modpack as a base for your own modpack, please credit:
End Progression by SipuliEmbo
